note: Inventory of required evidence *classes* for each freeze field. Does not invent schedules, thresholds, difficulty values, envelopes, or sample counts. Not H9 evidence and not a TDI-9.2 authorization. TDI-9.3 (#195) Boolean IR is explicitly non-authorizing for every 9.1 pin.

closed_rejection_taxonomy.evidence_class_definition: Closed ReferenceRejectionCode vocabulary with machine-readable rejection records, without freezing rejection-rate thresholds or populations.

p1_p2_p3_difficulty_parameters.evidence_class_definition: Non-final Dev/Val selection of P1/P2/P3 difficulty parameters.

c0_c1_schedules.evidence_class_definition: Non-final Dev/Val selection of C0/C1 schedules.

c2_c3_thresholds_and_verification_cadenc.evidence_class_definition: Non-final Dev/Val selection of C2/C3 thresholds and verification cadence.

permitted_observation_vector.evidence_class_definition: Explicit experimental subset of PolicyObservation fields for scientific freeze. PolicyObservation as an 8-field carrier type (#123) and TDI-9.3 Boolean IR (#195) are NOT this evidence class.
permitted_observation_vector.blocking_until: explicit experimental observation-subset selection (not Boolean IR)
permitted_observation_vector.non_authorizing_note: TDI-9.3 Boolean policy synthesis surfaces must not be treated as authorizing this pin.

common_max_compute_memory_envelopes.evidence_class_definition: Frozen numeric ResourceEnvelope constants. The caller-supplied ResourceEnvelope *type* is insufficient.

paired_interval_method.evidence_class_definition: Family-wise coverage evidence under frozen TDI-9.0 alpha rules selecting the interval method.
paired_interval_method.blocking_until: family-wise coverage selection under frozen alpha

paired_resampling_replicate_count.evidence_class_definition: Family-wise coverage evidence selecting replicate count under frozen TDI-9.0 alpha rules.

paired_resampling_seed.evidence_class_definition: Explicit Domains seed declaration for paired resampling.

development_validation_population_domain.evidence_class_definition: Disjoint development/validation domains; no final seeds.

future_public_entropy_source_event_encod.evidence_class_definition: Entropy source/event/encoding frozen before the public value is knowable.

final_seed_derivation_contract.evidence_class_definition: Deterministic map from future public entropy to final seeds.

agent_search_safe_policy_mutation_contra.evidence_class_definition: Closed agent-search-safe policy mutation/evaluation contract for Dev/Val only. TDI-9.3 Boolean search design is non-authorizing.
agent_search_safe_policy_mutation_contra.non_authorizing_note: TDI-9.3 (#195) does not authorize this pin.

h9_classifier_aggregation_plumbing.evidence_class_definition: Software transcription plumbing of H9 classifier/aggregation rules from the frozen TDI-9.0 preregistration. Preregistration text alone is insufficient.

non_authorizing_rule: TDI-9.3 Boolean policy synthesis (#195) is ACTIVE DESIGN / NON-FINAL. Citing those surfaces must never authorize a TDI-9.1 freeze pin (including permitted_observation_vector and agent_search_safe_policy_mutation_contract).
